title: [finding] the ADR-0130 fixture nests packages one level deeper than both docs readers, so a doc there is dropped silently
body:
Path: none | 多包 artifact 文档深度 | 与 #19246 同族,复现后定

Filed by the `domain:cli` execution PM seat (#6024, session `session_01QCdUBjM47SxioST9z5Zwdf`) out of the #18431 patch round (PR #18962), where it arrived as **review flag H** of the at-tier contract review of record (`5747199582`). ⛔ Filed bare: `finding` only; `domain:*`, type and priority are triage's.

Dedupe words: `src/packages/PKG/docs depth` · `ADR-0130 fixture nesting` · `package docs dropped silently` · `#18428 warning depth`.

## The shape

The in-repo ADR-0130 fixture (`examples/app-multi-package`) nests its packages at **`src/packages/PKG/`** — one level deeper than **both** readers that look for package docs:

| reader | depth it walks |
|:--|:--|
| the #18428 uncollected-directory **warning** | `src/PKG/docs/` |
| the #18431 per-package **collector** | `src/PKG/docs/` |
| ⚠️ the in-repo fixture | **`src/packages/PKG/`** |

⇒ a doc placed at `src/packages/PKG/docs/` is **dropped with nothing printed** — ⛔ not collected, and ⛔ not even warned about, because `sweepPackageDocsDirectories` walks only the immediate children of `src/`.

⭐ **Silent is the whole finding.** An uncollected directory that *warns* is a papercut; one that produces `0 collected` and no `docs/uncollected-directory` is indistinguishable from having written no docs at all.

## Instrument

Add one Markdown file under `examples/app-multi-package/src/packages/core/docs/`, run `os build`, and observe **`0 collected`** and **no** `docs/uncollected-directory` warning.

## Scope

⛔ **Pre-existing, and correctly NOT widened by PR #18962** — the fixture ships no docs at all today, so the in-repo blast radius is **zero**. That is why it is a card and not a rider.

⭐ Direction for whoever takes it: #14122 / the hotcrm split will settle **which depth the convention means**, so the fix is probably *"read both depths, or warn at the deeper one"* rather than *"move the fixture"* — ⛔ moving the fixture would hide the question rather than answer it.

⚠️ PR #18962's own `## Acceptance notes` already records this observation and the zero blast radius. **Carry that wording across rather than re-deriving it.**
